title: Prelude et Divertissement
identity: Billaudot lists Robert Clérisse’s Prélude et divertissement for saxophone and piano or organ, catalog AF0049-D. Forsyths reports an ABRSM Grade 6 selection, but the official ABRSM Saxophone syllabus checked for this review did not list the title.

evidence.claim: Billaudot’s opened product page identifies Prélude et divertissement as AF0049-D, categorized “Saxophone and piano or organ,” with the product title specifying E-flat saxophone. The page contained no visible score-preview link.
Forsyths listing reports ABRSM Grade 6 saxophone exam selection and alternate instrumental parts.

ABRSM Practical Music Grades: Woodwind Syllabus from 2022 was searched for Clérisse and Prélude et divertissement; neither appeared in the accessible syllabus text. This does not establish whether an older or alternate syllabus listed it.

collection_flag: Published saxophone/piano-or-organ work with external Grade 6 exam-list claim.
gaps: Billaudot product page was opened but contained no visible score preview; notation was not inspected.
The reported ABRSM Grade 6 selection was not found in the official 2022-onward saxophone syllabus checked; older or alternate syllabus status remains unknown.
Exact saxophone options and whether alternate instrumental parts are included remain uncertain.
